sections.title: THE GAME
sections.content: **Impact** is a first-person shooter built around the ability to **reshape and manipulate the environment**. It mixes fast action with environmental puzzles. As you progress, you uncover secrets about your journey.

sections.title: MY ROLE
sections.content: I was **in charge of the game design** and the documentation, while also building some of the levels. We started from scratch, with the **force impact** as the very first thing to prototype. Everything else, from the enemies to the puzzles, grew out of that one mechanic.

sections.title: DESIGN CHALLENGES
sections.content: Early on, we realized the game would have to handle **thousands of cubes** at once. Optimization became the real challenge, and we had to drop a few ideas we loved. From then on, every new feature was weighed against what the game could run.
